set -euo pipefail; CANDIDATE=53e270120a0bc61b2af422c6faa4fcd6789f43c3; cd "$HOME/local-agent"; test "$(git branch --show-current)" = main; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$CANDIDATE"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"; git fetch --quiet origin main v4.13.0-staging --tags; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$CANDIDATE"; test "$(git rev-parse origin/v4.13.0-staging)" = "$CANDIDATE"; test "$(git rev-parse 'v4.13.0^{}')" = "$CANDIDATE"; python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
out = subprocess.check_output(['git','worktree','list','--porcelain'], text=True)
blocks = [b for b in out.strip().split('\n\n') if b.strip()]
for block in blocks:
    lines = block.splitlines()
    wt = next((line.split(' ',1)[1] for line in lines if line.startswith('worktree ')), None)
    branch = next((line.split(' ',1)[1] for line in lines if line.startswith('branch ')), None)
    if branch == 'refs/heads/v4.13.0-staging':
        if not wt:
            raise SystemExit('staging worktree missing path')
        p = Path(wt).resolve()
        if p == Path.home().joinpath('local-agent').resolve():
            raise SystemExit('refusing to remove production worktree')
        subprocess.run(['git','worktree','remove','--force',str(p)], check=True)
PY
    git worktree prune; if git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/heads/v4.13.0-staging; then git branch -D v4.13.0-staging; fi; git push origin --delete v4.13.0-staging; if git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin refs/heads/v4.13.0-staging >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'staging branch still exists' >&2; exit 4; fi; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$CANDIDATE"; test "$(git rev-parse 'v4.13.0^{}')" = "$CANDIDATE"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"; echo LOCAL_AGENT_V413_STAGING_CLEANUP=PASS
